paragraphs: The XE P250 is a current-era petrol variant of the X760-generation Jaguar XE, which has been in production since 2015. It uses the Ingenium AJ200, a 2.0-litre four-cylinder petrol engine. This is a modern turbocharged unit that's part of Jaguar Land Rover's modular family of engines, introduced to replace older Ford-sourced units. The XE P250 is one of the mainstream petrol variants in the range, sitting alongside the P200 and P300.

cards.body: A 2.0L I4 Petrol engine fitted to the XE P250 - X760 (2015-present).
